newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Iusacell raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Iusacell raised to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said its Latin America telecommunications analyst Patrick Jurczak had raised its rating on Mexico's Grupo Iusacell to "buy" from "hold"

-- It said the company's announcement that Bell Atlantic Corp will assume control of the group's business operations from the Peralta family is "a positive step toward approval" of a 450 MHz wireless local loop project and was expected to remove "any political concerns that might have prevented the Mexican government" from granting Iusacell the licence
--ING Barings said Jurczak's news target price was $12 per ADR, up from $8-$10.
"Should the stock reach Mr Jurczak's new target, it would represent a 71 percent increase from Monday's closing price", it said
